themes.description: Users experienced frequent app crashes, failed installations, and login issues due to various causes such as authorization problems, one-time password (OTP) verification failures, and poor app responsiveness.
themes.business_impact: Repeats of the same issues may lead to loss of user trust, negatively impacting the app's reputation and affecting its overall performance metrics like user acquisition and retention.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The inconsistent user experience might be attributed to technical debt, inadequate testing, or inefficient error handling mechanisms within the app.
themes.action_plan:
• Develop and integrate more robust error-handling mechanisms, enhance app testing frameworks, and improve user feedback channels
• Engage with the quality assurance team to ensure timely and efficient bug fixes, Implement user authentication redesign to prevent authorization issues
• Regularly monitor app performance metrics and user feedback to gauge app stability and make data-driven decisions

themes.description: Users are experiencing difficulties viewing charts, with symptoms including slow loading times, blank screens, and inability to view charts.
themes.business_impact: Cart display issues may lead to decreased user satisfaction, increased churn rate, and a negative impact on the platform's reputation.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The root cause of this issue is likely related to inefficient code or insufficient resources allocated to chart rendering.
themes.action_plan:
• Review and optimize chart rendering code
• Increase resources allocated to chart rendering
• Implement caching mechanisms to improve loading times
• Conduct user testing to identify areas for improvement
